pr_title: Fix PopupMenu unresponsive on right side of menu
pr_comments:
Hi @nathanfranke, @akien-mga.

Unfortunately I cannot reproduce the issue on my PR... not sure what is going on - maybe it is a platform specific issue? Anyway, this PR breaks what this piece of code tries to solve - not selecting items when trying to select the scrollbar. See below video of my test.
![scrollbar_selects](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41730826/91911888-5a0a7980-ecf5-11ea-93f6-f1ab5c59a718.gif)

So, the reason this code is required is because of the below situation. The scroll container just renders the scrollbar above the content. This is why I used the control rect initially, as it already accounts for the margin container. However, the scroll container rect would also work, as in my review below.
![popup-menu-diagram](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/41730826/91912153-e2891a00-ecf5-11ea-8065-d9ba04bb2f1f.png)
I chose option "A" since it seemed more elegant :smile:
All good on my end after a test, thanks!

issue_context.title: X11: Can't add effects to Audio Bus, selection impossible in popup
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
44e89cb88f7e982d7298e640f0828608bd3c5784


**OS/device including version:**
Mageia 8 x64, Plasma 5 on X11 with KWin


**Issue description:**
In the current `master` branch, I can't select audio effects to add to an audio bus in the popup menu with the mouse:
![Screenshot_20200904_133609](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4701338/92235209-9aaff180-eeb3-11ea-82ca-92216fd3cef5.png)
I can however select items with the arrow keys and <kbd>Return</kbd>.

Possibly a regression from #41640 (CC @EricEzaM), otherwise might be a general X11 window issue (CC @pouleyKetchoupp).

**Steps to reproduce:**
- Open project on X11
- Select Audio bottom panel
- Click "Add Effect"
- Try to select an effect

**Minimal reproduction project:**
n/a
comments: This is fixed by #41689, so indeed a regression from #41640.
Awesome, already solved before I get to look at the ticket :P

review_comments: Option b) also subtract get_theme_stylebox("panel")->get_offset().x to account for the width of the right hand side margin.
